messages:
Ida: quick follow-up from the postmortem — two recurring patterns we need owners on: (1) multi-region routing table drift that caused 30% of traffic to stick to eu-west, (2) delayed restores from cross-region backups. Can we split actions and timelines?
Sam: I can own the Restore Runbook update and the step-by-step checklist. aiming for EOD Thursday for a first pass.
Maria: I will take backup retention policy + verification scripts. proposing automated weekly restore verification in a sandbox region.
Lin: sign me up for routing tests + drift detection. I’ll add drift alerts into telemetry and a weekly routing conformance job.
Tenaya: heads up — Dedicated customers need advance notice for any game day that hits production routing. I can coordinate communications and windows.
Ida: thanks. can we add owners to the tracker with clear success criteria? e.g., runbook: updated steps + CI-checked playbook; backups: automated restore ran and checksum validated; routing: alerts firing <5m after drift.
Sam: noted. success criteria for runbook: 1) runbook lives in docs/redwood/dr-restore.md, 2) a CI job runs the dry-run and creates an artifact, 3) playbook reviewed by infra.
Maria: for backups: implement cross-region snapshot verify script. sample command I’ll use in sandbox:
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/prod/snap-2026-03-15.tar.gz /tmp/ && sha256sum /tmp/snap-2026-03-15.tar.gz
# then spin up restore job: scripts/restore-to-sandbox.sh /tmp/snap-2026-03-15.tar.gz
```
Lin: routing tests plan: a) nightly config diff of route tables vs canonical template, b) active canary traffic test between regions, c) telemetry alert if >2% persistence for 10m. I’ll PR a lambda to run the diff.
OpsBot: FYI — created ticket RD-5873 for runbook updates and RD-5874 for backup verification.
Ida: perfect. owners and tentative timelines: Sam -> runbook (EOD Thu), Maria -> backup script + weekly verify (next Tue), Lin -> routing tests & alerts (end of next week), Tenaya -> comms & game-day windows (coord by Tue). please confirm or adjust.
Sam: confirmed. I’ll drop a short PR referencing RD-5873 and tag @Lin for any infra commands.
Maria: confirmed. I’ll add a cron job in staging and post results to #eng-sre.
Lin: confirmed but need node access for the diff script. @Ida can you open short access ticket?
Ida: will open it now and link to RD-5876.
Tenaya: I’ll draft the communications calendar and propose two 2-hour windows for the cross-region game day: Tue 03/30 22:00 UTC or Thu 04/01 03:00 UTC. prefer Tue.
Sam: prefer Tue as well. less impact for APAC.
Ida: decision: Tue 03/30 22:00 UTC. Maria/Lin/Sam — please treat the game day as milestone: runbook updated, backup verify green, routing tests in canary.
Maria: we should add a smoke test for restored data integrity (sample queries). I’ll include a simple SQL checksum comparison in the restore script.
Lin: I’ll add a pre-game-day traffic switch simulation and a rollback checklist to the runbook.
OpsBot: tagging stakeholders: @Platform, @CustomerSuccess.
Tenaya: I’ll schedule the customer notices and a short post-game survey for impacted teams.
Ida: quick risk note — we still have an intermittent S3 latency alert pattern. Maria, add that to your verification so we catch S3 throttling during restores.
Maria: adding S3 latency thresholds and retry backoffs to the script.
Sam: one more ask — add a small section in the runbook for partial restores and how to reconcile KV cache state after restore. I’ll draft it.
Lin: and I’ll add routing policy validation to the CD pipeline so future deploys fail on invalid route templates.
Ida: awesome. can everyone post a 1-line status update in this thread by Monday EOD? we’ll close the action tracker after game day verified green.
Sam: will do.
Maria: will do.
Lin: will do.
Tenaya: will do.
Ida: thanks all — adding owners into RD-5873/4/6 and creating a simple checkbox list in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
